paragraphs.source_en: Some such conversation was being carried on between us, Mr. Squash smiling at my abrupt way of speaking, when we heard a young woman's lively laugh at the entrance. On looking back, whom should we see but a great apparition, a beauty of milky complexion, of high stature, with her hair dressed in fashionable style! An old matron about forty-five was with her; they were seen standing in front of the ticket window. paragraphs.source_en: the presence of the fair lady, I had forgotten all about Mr. Green Squash and had been all attention to her every movement, when all at once he left the seat beside me and approached the young lady and her mother with his usual slow steps. This surprised me not a little as the suspicion she might be Madonna crossed my mind. The three were soon seen before the booking office exchanging formal greetings. Distance made their conversation inaudible.
